method: Independent calculation from published coordinates and saved observations; no HBPLUS execution or C-source translation
split: first 32 sorted PDB identifiers in pinned hbonds.parquet

backbone_rotation.metric: median absolute D-H-A angle difference in degrees
backbone_rotation.note: The manual's four-degree angle description alone did not recover the observed implementation convention.

lysine_ammonium.fit: least squares of D-H-A degree residual and 10 times H-A angstrom residual; closest of three staggered H positions
lysine_ammonium.note: Empirical calibration constants, not a claim about HBPLUS source constants.

review.restatement_flag: fixed the repeated final caveat; retained local usage warning so standalone instructions remain accurate
review.specifics_flag: verified numerical values against calibration calculations and recorded them here
